text:
maria: Heads-up — we're seeing ~12% increase in per-token cost on /generate since kernel-picker tweak last night. Need a token-level split view (kernel/runtime/kv/cache) in dashboards to align billing and triage.

aj: Can you paste a minimal repro and sample metrics? I want token latency histogram and KV hit rate to start.

maria: Quick sample from nightly run (aggregated per-request):
```json
{"tokens":120345, "avg_ms_per_token":24.1, "p95_ms_per_token":38.7, "kv_hit_rate":0.68, "kernel_ms":15.6, "kv_ms":6.1, "overhead_ms":2.4}
```

liam: We rolled kernel-picker v2 at 02:30 UTC. It prefers fused-gemm for seq > 512, but might pick it for borderline short sequences because of new scoring. That could increase kernel_ms for typical short queries due to memcpy + kernel init. I'll run a microprofile across seq buckets. @maria

sophia: Also check batching heuristics — v2 adjusted the batch cutoff so small sequences are often in smaller batches now. Smaller batches = worse amortization of kernel setup. We need per-route batch-size distribution in the dashboard alongside token splits.

perf-bot: perfbot: profile job 1799991111-krn completed: p50 token_ms 13.2 -> 14.9, p95 token_ms 18.2 -> 21.4, KV miss rate +3.1pt. Full trace: https://perf.redwood/job/1799991111

aj: Proposal: implement a `per_token_splitview` metric set with labels: [route, model_version, kernel_variant, batch_size_bucket, kv_hit]. Roll up at ingestion: counters for tokens_by_kernel, tokens_by_kv, token_time_ms_by_kernel. Sample at 1% during rollout to control cardinality.

liam: I can emit aggregated counters from runtime per-request: `tokens_total`, `tokens_kernel_{variant}`, `tokens_kv_hit`, and `token_time_ms_bucket` histograms. Low overhead if aggregated at request-close instead of per-token. Will tag with `kernel_variant` but limit to known variants (fused-gemm, matmul, int8-fused).

maria: Dashboard ask: per-route unit economics = (cost_per_token * tokens_served) + infra overhead. Who owns the console tile for this? @ben?

ben: I'll own the dashboard. Prefer Prometheus-style counters + exemplars linking to traces. We should be careful with `kernel_variant` label cardinality; we should map unknown variants to `other`. Also need a small doc on how kernel selection maps to billing SKU.

sophia: Add a regression alert: if cost_per_token increases >5% (relative) over a 24h rolling baseline or if p95 token_ms delta >10% => auto triage.

aj: Agreed. I'll open RFC + ticket with rollout plan: sampling, label caps, dashboard wireframe, and alerts.

maria: Thanks — I'll attach a short replay example and the raw nightly logs in the ticket. Minimal log snippet below: 
```
[2026-03-17T02:29:52Z] req=abc123 model=xlarge seq=64 batch=3 kernel=matmul -> selected=fused-gemm kernel_ms=19.7 kv_hit=false
[2026-03-17T02:29:52Z] req=abc124 model=xlarge seq=16 batch=1 kernel=matmul -> selected=fused-gemm kernel_ms=12.4 kv_hit=false
[2026-03-17T02:30:11Z] rollout: kernel-picker v2 -> traffic: 100%
```

liam: I'll instrument per-request aggregates in the next patch and add unit tests to ensure label bounds. Punting on per-token emission.

aj: Thanks everyone — RFC coming in ~1d. :thumbsup:

maria: tagging this thread for visibility in eng-oncall and product. We'll prioritize the metric schema before the next model rollout.
